subject: german

rounds.lie: “Wir sollten Energie sparen” means “We should waste energy”.
rounds.why: Wrong: “sparen” means “to save”. To waste is “verschwenden”.
rounds.truth: “Wir sollten Energie sparen” means “We should save energy”.

rounds.lie: “Ich wohne in einem Reihenhaus” means “I live in a detached house”.
rounds.why: Wrong: “das Reihenhaus” is a “terraced house”. A detached house is “das Einfamilienhaus” (freistehend).
rounds.truth: “Ich wohne in einem Reihenhaus” means “I live in a terraced house”.

rounds.lie: “Wir sollten mehr recyceln” means “We recycled more”.
rounds.why: “Wir sollten” is the conditional “we should”. “We recycled” is “wir haben recycelt”.
rounds.truth: “Wir sollten mehr recyceln” means “We should recycle more”.
truths: “Die Umwelt schützen” means “to protect the environment”.

rounds.lie: “Zurzeit wohne ich in der Stadt” means “I used to live in the city”.
rounds.why: “Zurzeit” means “at the moment / currently”. “I used to live” is “früher habe ich gewohnt”.
rounds.truth: “Zurzeit wohne ich in der Stadt” means “At the moment I live in the city”.
truths: “Müll trennen” means “to separate the rubbish (for recycling)”.

rounds.lie: “Gestern bin ich zu einem Konzert gegangen” means “Tomorrow I will go to a concert”.
rounds.why: “Bin... gegangen” is the perfect tense = “I went”. “Tomorrow I will go” is “Morgen gehe ich / werde ich gehen”.
rounds.truth: “Gestern bin ich zu einem Konzert gegangen” means “Yesterday I went to a concert”.
truths: “Das Oktoberfest” is a folk festival in Munich.
“Ich folge vielen Influencern” means “I follow many influencers”.

rounds.lie: “Es gibt viele Geschäfte” means “There are many businesses to do”.
rounds.why: Wrong: here “die Geschäfte” means “shops”. (“Das Geschäft” can mean business, but “viele Geschäfte” in a town context = many shops.)
rounds.truth: “Es gibt viele Geschäfte” means “There are many shops”.
truths: “der Stadtrand” means “the outskirts of the town”.

rounds.lie: “Ich sehe die Nachrichten” means “I see the neighbours”.
rounds.why: Wrong: “die Nachrichten” means “the news”. Neighbours would be “die Nachbarn”.
rounds.truth: “Ich sehe die Nachrichten” means “I watch the news”.
